# Engine Company Hazmat

> HAZWOPER and hazmat training for fire departments: 40-hour fire/hazmat, incident command, responder refresher, awareness, gas detection and decon, with guides to responder levels and decon.

Engine Company Hazmat (https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Awareness, 40 Hr Fire / Hazmat, Incident Command, Responder Refresher or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Awareness level training for every member of the department. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Emergency Response/Fire-Hazmat Teams](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-emergency-response-fire-hazmat-teams): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour HAZWOPER for fire and hazmat teams. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-emergency-response-fire-hazmat-teams?buy=589
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command for hazmat incidents. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [8 Hour HAZWOPER and Incident Command Refresher Training](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training): $249.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(8). The annual hazmat refresher with incident command review. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/8-hour-hazwoper-and-incident-command-refresher-training?buy=574
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Multi-gas meters and PIDs on scene. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Decontamination Procedures](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). A 20-minute decon module. Enroll: https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures?buy=584

## Guides

- [HAZWOPER for fire departments: which level does each member need?](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-for-fire-departments): OSHA's responder levels, applied to a fire department roster.
- [Decon on the fireground: gross, technical and mass decon](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/guides/decon-on-the-fireground): Three kinds of decon, when each is used and who runs them.
- [Keeping the annual hazmat refresher manageable](https://fire-departments.hazwoperosha.us/guides/annual-hazmat-refresher-fire): Meeting (q)(8) every year without burning a whole shift. Practical approaches for departments.
